Name: New Sandy for Seasonal Outfits
Author: rachelkel04
Description:
[size=4]🌟Happy 10th birthday to Stardew Valley🌟[/size]

[size=2]I started playing at the end of 2021 and have been returning to my lovely farm from time to time ever since. It was only last year that I decided to venture into the world of modding and try to create something. I still find the coding part a big challenge, but I love editing portraits and sprites. The Stardew modding community is incredible; I think they create a lovely new reality for such an amazing game.
[/size]

[size=3]To celebrate Modfest, I'm bringing Sandy! Our desert lady :D[/size]


I find Sandy a fascinating character, and I wanted to convey some of that fascination I feel for her in this mod. I imagine her as a very beautiful woman who likes to dress up, her hair always neatly styled with curly ends and different eye shadows each season :)

In the portraits, I changed her hair, eyes, nose, clothes (some more than others), and some details.

In the sprites, I modified her hair and some clothes based on the modifications I made in the portraits.


Just remember to disable the "Sandy" option in the Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic settings.

[size=1](I'm currently working on Leo, maybe a new mod is coming soon 👀)[/size]


[code]﻿[/code]

[size=5]Installation:[/size]

[list]
[*]Download the mod files and extract them to the Stardew Valley mods folder. (The path should be something like: C:\Program Files) Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods)
[*]Run the game normally.
[/list]

I hope you like it! Feel free to comment if you have any feedback or if something isn't working. Thank you!
